items.title: Files (explorer)
items.description: Default view: nested file tree with file icons, tabs, editor. The rail switches views. File icon style (brand by file type, or simple) is a setting.

items.title: Workbench - all add-ons on
items.description: Chosen layout: activity rail (Files, Search, Changes, PRs, Settings), explorer, tabs, status bar. No breadcrumbs. Header row: the file tabs, an empty drag area, then after a divider the title actions (Toggle sidebar, Open folder), another divider and the window buttons (minimize, maximize, close), all from the header-tail component. There is no separate OS title bar. Default theme is Nord Dark, taken from the owners VS Code. Green gutter bar marks lines added since the last commit.

items.title: Settings
items.description: Settings is a modal over the workbench, not a screen: the workbench stays visible behind a darkened overlay, the left nav picks the section, and the pane scrolls when its content is taller. Close with the X, Esc or a click on the overlay. Appearance (theme, file icons, diff layout, font size) and GitHub token. Applied instantly, stored locally.

items.title: Settings - Appearance
items.description: Theme picker: four themes (three dark, one light), applied instantly, saved locally. Colors are semantic tokens so a theme is just a set of values. Also editor font size. GitHub token lives in the GitHub section.

items.title: Workbench - simple icons
items.description: Same workbench with File icons set to Simple: one generic file icon and outlined folders, no brand marks.

items.title: Source control
items.description: Add-on: Source control. Needs a git repository for most features. Working changes and branch compare share one diff view, inline or side by side. Compare is read-only. Staging, discarding and committing only happen in Changes.

items.title: Changes - inline diff
items.description: Source control panel: commit box, staged and unstaged files. Selected file shows an inline diff, red removed / green added, word-level highlights. Stage or discard per hunk or per file. Commit disabled with nothing staged. Layout default is a setting.

items.title: Changes - side by side diff
items.description: Same view with Side by side on: old left, new right, changed lines paired, blank cell where a side has no line. Chosen per diff from the toolbar; default set in Appearance.

items.title: Compare branches
items.description: Read-only diff of base vs current branch (merge-base, like a PR). Base is chosen from a dropdown; the compare side is the current branch. File list with +/- counts.

items.title: Compare - choose base
items.description: Filterable branch list opened from the base selector. Local branches only in v1.

items.title: Pull requests
items.description: Add-on: Pull requests (needs Source control and a GitHub token). Needs a GitHub token. Browsing is read-only and fetches nothing; Review changes fetches the PR ref and diffs it locally.

items.title: Pull requests - detail
items.description: Left: open PRs with status dot (checks), number, author, age. Selected PR shows description, branch, checks summary and files changed. Review changes fetches refs/pull/N/head and opens the diff.

items.title: Pull request - review diff
items.description: Local read-only diff of the PR against its base, same diff view as compare. No comments in v1. Back returns to the list.

items.title: GitHub - connect
items.description: Paste a personal access token. Saved in Windows Credential Manager, never in files or git.

items.title: GitHub - connected
items.description: Shows the account and the end of the token. Replace or remove it.

items.title: Search
items.description: Add-on: Search. Symbol results use a built-in outline, no language server. Find text across the folder. Search only, no replace in v1. A result opens the file at that line.

items.title: Search in files
items.description: Sidebar search: query with case, whole word and regex toggles, optional files-to-include filter, results grouped by file with the match highlighted. Click a result to open the file at that line. Search only, no replace in v1.

items.title: Launch
items.description: Entry flow. Open folder or recent project leads to the workbench. A folder without a git repository still opens, with Source control and Pull requests unavailable.

items.title: Launch
items.description: First screen when no folder is open. Open folder (Ctrl+O) or pick a recent project; recents show path and last branch. Shows GitHub connection state. A header row holds only the drag area and the window buttons (the window-controls component). Nothing else on this screen.

items.title: Changes - not a git repository
items.description: Folder without a repo: tree, search and editing work; Source control and Pull requests explain they need a repository.

items.title: File context menu
items.description: Right-click a file. Open, Copy, Cut, Copy path, Copy relative path, Rename (F2), Delete (Del, to Recycle Bin), Reveal in File Explorer.

items.title: Folder context menu
items.description: Right-click a folder. Adds New file, New folder, Paste and Find in folder (prefills the Search files filter). Right-click empty space in the tree for the same menu on the opened folder: New file, New folder, Paste, Copy path, Open in Terminal, Reveal; no Copy, Cut, Rename or Delete. A new name field is cancelled by Esc or a click anywhere else, which removes the entry it just made.

items.title: Rename in place
items.description: Name becomes an input, base name selected without the extension. Enter applies, Esc cancels. Refuses an existing name and shows the reason inline.

items.title: Delete confirmation
items.description: Deleting moves to the Recycle Bin, never permanent. Open tabs for the file close; if it has unsaved edits the dialog says so.

items.title: Tab context menu
items.description: Right-click a tab. Close, Close others, Close to the right, Close all, Pin tab, Copy path, Copy relative path, Reveal in File Explorer.

items.title: Pinned tab
items.description: Pinned tabs sit at the left, compact with a pin mark and no close button, separated from the rest. Close all and Close others skip pinned tabs. Right-click a pinned tab offers Unpin.

items.title: Search - Files
items.description: Fuzzy file-name search across the folder; matched letters highlighted. Click opens the file.

items.title: Search - Symbols
items.description: Functions, classes and properties from a built-in outline (tree-sitter), no language server needed. Click jumps to the declaration.

items.title: Search everywhere (Ctrl+Shift+O)
items.description: Ctrl+Shift+O: one modal from anywhere. Tabs: All, Files, Symbols, Text; Tab switches type; Enter opens the result. Ctrl+P opens it on the Files tab. Results open the file at the line. Part of the Search add-on.

items.title: Search everywhere - Symbols
items.description: Type scoped to symbols. Rows show kind, name and location.

items.title: Settings - Keyboard shortcuts
items.description: All actions grouped, filterable. Click a shortcut to rebind. Defaults follow common editor habits; the changed ones are stored locally.

items.title: Shortcuts - recording
items.description: Waiting for the new keys. Esc cancels, Backspace clears.

items.title: Shortcuts - conflict
items.description: A key already in use is not silently stolen: the owner is named and the user chooses Assign or Cancel.

items.title: Settings - Languages
items.description: Language is chosen by file extension. Built-in highlighting for 24 languages. Optional language servers per language: off by default, uses servers already installed, started on demand, stopped when idle. Definition, references and back/forward only. The table scrolls inside the modal when it is taller than the window.

items.title: Code navigation
items.description: Language mode and optional language-server features: go to definition, find references, back/forward. Servers are not bundled and are off by default.

items.title: Language mode picker
items.description: The language of a file is detected from its extension automatically. This picker, opened from the status bar, only overrides it for the current file (for example an unusual extension). Unknown extensions open as plain text.

items.title: Ctrl+hover a symbol
items.description: With Ctrl held, a symbol with a known definition is underlined and a small tip shows its signature. Ctrl+Click goes to the definition; Ctrl+Click on a definition opens references. F12 and Shift+F12 do the same from the keyboard. Alt+Left goes back.

items.title: References peek
items.description: Modal listing every reference grouped by file, with a code preview of the selected one. Up/Down move, Enter opens the file at that line, Esc closes. Needs the language server on for this language.

items.title: Editor
items.description: Editing states beyond typing: find, wrap, safety prompts, external changes, large and binary files, git blame, split panes.

items.title: Find in file (Ctrl+F)
items.description: Floating bar top-right of the editor: query, match count, case / whole word / regex toggles, previous / next, close. All matches highlighted, current one stronger. Enter next, Shift+Enter previous, Esc closes.

items.title: Word wrap (Alt+Z)
items.description: Long lines wrap at the editor edge; continuation rows have no line number. Toggle with Alt+Z or the Wrap item in the status bar. Per-file setting, off by default for code.

items.title: Unsaved changes prompt
items.description: Closing a tab or the window with unsaved edits asks Save, Don't save or Cancel. With several files it lists them. Nothing is closed until the user answers.

items.title: File changed on disk
items.description: If another tool edits an open file: with no unsaved edits it reloads silently; with unsaved edits this bar offers Reload or Keep mine. Keep mine means the next save overwrites the disk version.

items.title: Reopen closed tab
items.description: Closing a tab shows a brief toast with Reopen. Ctrl+Shift+T reopens the most recently closed tab, repeatedly.

items.title: Large file (read-only)
items.description: Above a size limit a file opens read-only, without highlighting or language features, only the visible lines held in memory. Open normally is a deliberate click.

items.title: Binary file
items.description: Binary files are never loaded into the editor. Only Reveal in File Explorer.

items.title: Git blame - current line
items.description: The caret line shows author, age and commit subject, faded, after the code. Right-click a line number for the line menu, or press Ctrl+Alt+B. Toggle blame off in the same menu.

items.title: Git blame - gutter and commit card
items.description: Ctrl+Alt+B shows a blame column for the whole file, grouped by commit. Hovering a group shows a card: author, age, hash, message, Copy hash. Needs a git repository; uncommitted lines show nothing.

items.title: Terminal
items.description: Embedded terminal panel at the bottom. Runs the user shell in the project folder. Costs memory per session: sessions are created only when opened.

items.title: Embedded terminal (Ctrl+backtick)
items.description: Add-on: Terminal (Heavy: a separate process per session). Bottom panel with a shell session (PowerShell by default, or cmd / Git Bash). Opens in the project folder or the folder chosen from the explorer. Multiple sessions as tabs. Closing the panel keeps sessions alive until closed explicitly.

items.title: Discard changes confirmation
items.description: Discard is irreversible, so it asks first. Applies to a file or a single hunk; the text names what is reverted.

items.title: Changes - clean tree
items.description: Nothing to commit. Offers Compare with a branch.

items.title: PRs - no token
items.description: Without a GitHub token the panel says so and links to Settings > GitHub. Nothing is requested.

items.title: PRs - GitHub unreachable
items.description: Network or token failure shows an inline error with Retry. Local branches and diffs keep working.

items.title: Split panes
items.description: Add-on: Split panes. Two editor groups side by side, each with its own tabs. Split right from the tab menu or Ctrl+Backslash. Two groups maximum in v1.

items.title: Viewers
items.description: Non-code files open in read-only viewers inside a tab: images, SVG, PDF, and Markdown preview. Binary files that have no viewer are never loaded.

items.title: Image viewer
items.description: PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP and BMP open in a read-only viewer: size and dimensions, fit and zoom, transparency checkerboard.

items.title: SVG viewer
items.description: SVG opens as a preview with a Preview / Code switch; Code is the normal editor with highlighting.

items.title: PDF viewer
items.description: Read-only, page-by-page scrolling, zoom and fit width. Rendered by the Windows built-in PDF component, so nothing extra is bundled.

items.title: Markdown preview
items.description: Code, Side by side or Preview from the toolbar (Ctrl+Shift+V toggles). Rendered Markdown scrolls in step with the code. Headings, lists, code blocks, tables and links; no scripts.

items.title: Add-ons
items.description: Core is always on: folder, tree, tabs, editing, find, wrap, highlighting, themes, shortcuts. Everything else is a first-party add-on, off by default, turned on in Settings. No third-party plugin API.

items.title: Workbench - core only (default)
items.description: A fresh install: only the file tree, tabs and editor. The rail shows Files and Settings; no Search, Changes or Pull requests until their add-ons are on. Status bar has only position, wrap, language and encoding.

items.title: Settings - Add-ons
items.description: Nine optional add-ons, each with what it does and a weight (Light: code only; Medium: memory while in use; Heavy: a separate process while in use). All off in a fresh install. Off means not loaded, no memory; its rail button, menus and settings are hidden.

items.title: Add-on needs another
items.description: Turning on an add-on that depends on another asks to turn on both. Turning Source control off while Pull requests is on turns off both, after the same prompt.

items.title: Hint to enable an add-on
items.description: Opening a file that an off add-on could help with (Markdown, image, PDF) shows one dismissible bar offering to turn it on. Not now hides it for that file type.

items.title: Sidebar - drag to resize
items.description: The divider between sidebar and editor is draggable: it shows a grip while hovered or dragged, and the width. Minimum 180 px, maximum 600 px; dragging below the minimum collapses it. Double-click resets to the default. One width for every view, remembered between sessions.

items.title: Sidebar - collapsed
items.description: No separate collapse button. Collapse by clicking the active rail button, Ctrl+B, or dragging the divider until it closes. The rail strip always stays visible; clicking a rail button, Ctrl+B or dragging out from the strip shows the sidebar again at its last width.

items.title: Sidebar - drag until closed
items.description: Dragging the divider below the minimum width dims the sidebar and shows Release to collapse; releasing hides it. Dragging back out from the rail edge shows it again.

items.title: Line number menu
items.description: Right-click a line number. A small menu of line options; today only Git blame, which toggles the blame column like Ctrl+Alt+B. More line actions can join the menu later. Only offered while the Source control add-on is on and the folder is a git repository.

items.title: Many tabs
items.description: More tabs than fit: the tab strip clips at the title actions and scrolls sideways with the wheel, and the active tab is scrolled into view when it changes. The drag area, title actions and window buttons never move.

items.title: Command palette
items.description: Ctrl+Shift+P (Search add-on): every action with its shortcut, filtered by fuzzy text. Up and Down choose, Enter runs it where the caret was, Esc closes. Actions that need an editor do nothing without one.
